messages:
Karen - Partnerships: Quick sync request — we need a tight plan for multi-tier onramp + joint announce cadence across H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Key asks: regional phased cutover dates, demo slot windows for SI partners, and a minimal handoff matrix for marketplace listing teams. Who can own the matrix by EOD?
Anna Chen: I can own the matrix. Will pull capacity numbers from infra and map to timelines. Need firmware/bios risk flags from HW liaisons.
Liam (HW): Thanks Anna. From partners' side: H100 capacity looks healthy in NA for mid-May; H200 is green but limited per-rack in EU (est. late May). MI300 forecast is softer — tentative June GA for our partners. Gaudi units are available for early access pilots (limited).
Sarah (PM): Can we propose two parallel demo waves? Wave A = NA (H100 + Gaudi pilots), Wave B = EU (H200 + MI300 catch-up). We should reserve 3 contiguous demo days per region.
Marco - Ops: Heads up — recent H200 firmware push may require a 48h smoke test in staging. If we plan EU demos early May we need image/driver freeze by 04-15.
Raj Patel: Which image tag should SIs use? I recommend `hw-marketplace/preview:v2025-05-01` and a short runbook. Also add KV-cache tuning flag for long seq tests.
Liam (HW): Confirming runbook tag is fine. We'll provide a fallback VM SKU for partners with limited PCIe lanes. Noted on the 48h smoke test.
Anna Chen: I'll draft the handoff matrix and share a minimal CSV with columns: region, model, earliest-demo, capacity, firmware-risk, SI-owner, marketplace-sku. Anyone object to that schema?
Sarah (PM): Sounds good. Add a column for "demo-contact" (primary + backup) and "embargo-window" so comms knows blackout.
Karen - Partnerships: Great. Action items: Anna to share CSV by EOD; Liam to confirm exact rack counts per region; Marco to confirm image freeze date and smoke window; Raj to publish runbook snippet. I'll coordinate comms and draft the marketplace pre-announcement copy once matrix is in. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Scheduled: `staging-smoke-test` job queued for 2025-04-16 03:00 UTC (depends on firmware freeze).
Marco - Ops: Quick note — if MI300 slips, propose we swap MI300 demos into a later Wave C rather than blocking EU Wave B. Keep fallback lanes documented.
Liam (HW): Agreed. I'll push a revised capacity CSV by 10:30 PT.
Anna Chen: Uploaded `onramp_matrix_draft.csv` to the partnership folder and pinged the owners. Sharing a short sample row: `NA,H100,2025-05-12,120 racks,low,Karen,sku_h100_preset,ops@redwood.com,embargo:2025-05-01-2025-05-14`
Sarah (PM): Perfect. I'll lock proposed demo days after Anna's final. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
